{{Otheruses|Battlelord}}
A '''battlelord''' was a type of [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] warrior on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The [[Donkuwah]], [[Korga]], and [[Pubam]] Duloks employed individuals of this vocation.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
